## Vectorization and lists

library(dplyr)

```{r}
sum(x[[1]]) # will succeed

```

```{r}
x <- list(a = 1:3, b = "hello", c = list(d = TRUE))
sum(x[[1]])
x[[1,2]]
```

```{r}
#Just an example
cms <- sample_n(tidyr::cms_patient_care, size = 4)
cms
```

```{r}
## Just an example
cms |> 
  mutate(metadata = list(
    women,
    vec = c("ab", "c"),
    lm(height ~ weight, data = women),
    NULL
  ), .after = ccn)
```

```{r}
counts <- counts <- c(100, 307, 323, 5000, 0, 10)
log10(counts)
make_loggable <- function(raw_counts) {
    raw_counts +1
}
 counts |>  make_loggable() |>  log10()
```

```{r}
## Complex functions
##map,purrr::map()
##Example
samples <- list(a = c(100, 0, 10),
                b = c(5000, 307, 42, 18),
                c = c(0, 250, 75, 3, 12))
samples
map(samples, make_loggable)
map(samples, \(x) x |> make_loggable() |> log10())
```

```{r}
library(purrr)
map_dbl(swiss, mean)
lapply(swiss, mean)
```

```{r}
ggplot(penguins,
       aes(x = bill_len, y = bill_dep, colour = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              formula = 'y ~ x',
              se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(vars(island)) +
  labs(title = "Species by Islands")

lm(bill_dep ~ bill_len, data = penguins)
summary(lm(bill_dep ~ bill_len, 
           data = penguins))

split_peng <- group_split(penguins, 
                          island, 
                          species)
map(split_peng, dim)
map_dbl(split_peng, nrow)

map(split_peng, \(x) {
  lm(bill_dep ~ bill_len, 
     data = x)
})
lm_all <- summary(lm(bill_dep ~ bill_len, ## R2
                     data = penguins))
str(lm_all, max.level = 1, give.attr = FALSE)
plit_peng |>
  map(\(x) lm(bill_dep ~ bill_len,
              data = x)) |> 
  map(summary) |>
  map(\(x) pluck(x, "R.squared"))
```

```{r}
##list as a tibble
tibble(numbers = 1:8,
       my_list = list(a = c("a", "b"), b = 2.56, 
                      c = c("a", "b", "c"), d = rep(TRUE, 4),
                      d = 2:3, e = 4:6, f = FALSE, g = c(1, 4, 5, 6)))
 penguins |>
  nest(.by = c(island, species))
penguins |>
  nest(.by = c(island, species)) |>
  mutate(model = map(data, 
                     \(x) lm(bill_dep ~ bill_len,
                          data = x)),
         summary = map(model, summary),
         r_squared = map_dbl(summary, "r.squared"))                    
```
```{r}

ChickWeight |> 
  group_split(Diet) |> 
  lapply(function(x) {
    model <- lm(weight ~ Time, data = x)
    summary(model)$coefficients["Time", "Estimate"]
  }) |> 
  unlist() |> 
  which.max()
```
